title: Press kit
about: Viavo is an AI voice assistant for drivers on iPhone and CarPlay. Press one button and say what you need, in any of 28 languages, and Viavo does it and answers out loud: a route with a stop on the way, places along the route, music and radio, calls and messages.
facts: 28, with a native voice in each
Polish, Czech, Romanian, Greek, Hungarian, Croatian, Serbian, Ukrainian
10 free credits, then Viavo Plus, monthly or yearly, with a free week
contact: Questions, interviews or other materials: write to us through the support page.
